name: Darius III
source: Berserker's True Name is Darius III, a valorous king of Ancient Persia. A character from the 4th Century BC. Known as the last emperor of the Achaemenid Dynasty. A "worthy rival" of Iskandar, the King of Conquerors of Macedonia, whom he faced in combat many times.
